**Job Title**

**Job Description Summary**

**Job Description**

**Our Purpose:**

At C&W Services, we live by the belief that “Better Never Settles.” We're dedicated to creating a positive impact globally and we're looking for talented individuals to join our team.

**C&W Services provides compelling benefits, including:**

* Weekly pay
* Comprehensive benefits starting on your first day
* Training, development, and advancement opportunities
* A clean and cutting-edge facility
* A safety-first culture

**About the Role:**

As an Automation Engineer (AE), you will support the site maintenance team to ensure operational performance and efficiency of Material Handling Equipment (MHE) control systems. You will partner with the maintenance team to troubleshoot and maintain equipment such as conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print-and-apply labeling systems, scales, HMI systems, control cabinets, and more. The AE provides support to the operations and maintenance teams by implementing solutions for complex problems and tracking related projects. You may lead and/or assist other technicians with their development through continuity of knowledge, all while working in a clean, climate-controlled, modern facility.

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Promoting a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
* Providing guidance on maintaining material handling control systems, industrial motor control systems, servo and frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
* Using your technical expertise to provide support with troubleshooting and modifying software projects for material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, Allen Bradley ControlLogix and CompactLogix PLC platform utilizing Rockwell’s software package, industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS-I, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems.
* Acting as the first level of escalation support for equipment automation issues and appropriately escalating downtime situations to vendors and/or network support teams to restore equipment operation.
* Applying subject matter expertise in material handling and electronic control systems to maximize building utilization of systems
* Monitoring MHE metrics and partnering with mechatronics technicians to resolve equipment electrical problems that create performance deficiencies, and performing control systems assessments to maintain and improve equipment reliability
* Partnering with facility Operations leadership, equipment vendors, and parts suppliers to plan and coordinate new technology installations, acting as the technical consultant for capital projects inside the building
* Communicating technical issues and project timelines with building leadership, operations, and the maintenance team, explaining production impacts and working closely with operations and engineering to ensure a thorough understanding of impact to systems

* 3+ years of cumulative work experience in the following areas, or a relevant 2-year degree plus 1 year of work experience in the following areas:

  + SCADA systems and KPIs
  + Interpreting and modifying mechanical and electrical drawings
  + Supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems
  + Equipment control components such as relays, motor starters, VFDs, HMIs, etc.
* High school or equivalent diploma
* Positive attitude and ability to effectively problem-solve

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Associate’s degree with a focus in Electronic Technology (or similar)
* Bachelor’s degree in a STEM-related field
* 4+ years of experience in the electrical field, or in control systems development, troubleshooting, and programming
* 4+ years of experience supporting advanced automation controls systems maintenance and development
* 3+ years of experience supporting a wide range of conveyors and sortation systems
* Leadership and project management experience

**Physical Demands:**

* Ability to reach overhead, kneel, squat, climb steps/ladders, use an aerial lift, and frequently lift a maximum of 50 lbs. of equipment
* Ability to perform tasks while wearing required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), which may include but is not limited to hard hat, face mask, face shield, and composite-toe shoes
* Regularly required to crouch or bend and reach to install/move equipment
* Movement between departments, floors, and properties to facilitate work, averaging 6 to 12 miles per day
* Work in a warehouse environment with fluctuating temperatures
* Regularly required to type on a computer for 1-2 hours per day

jobs.description:
**About Miso**

MISO develops technology that elevates human lives in the commercial kitchen.

We’re engineering production-ready robotic systems that tightly integrate perception, real-time decision making, and electromechanical controls to automate the most dangerous, least desirable tasks in food preparation. That means building software that understands the physical world as it actually behaves, and hardware that can execute precisely in the face of chaos. Success is measured in uptime, throughput, and trust from our customers, not demos.

Our flagship platform, Flippy, is already operating in high-volume restaurant kitchens across seven states. Zippy, our Kitchen Intelligence software centralizes all operational data in our broader ecosystem, expanding the role of AI enabled autonomy in real-world operations. Backed by industry leaders, including Ecolab (NYSE: ECL), Miso combines the stability of a proven commercial product with the technical depth and ambition of a company passionately innovating to solve foundational problems in robotics and restaurant operations.

If you’re excited by hard constraints, real customers, and the challenge of making software and machines perform reliably where failure isn’t an option, you’ll find meaningful problems to work on here.

As a **Software Engineer – Full Stack** at Miso Robotics, you will develop and expand the customer-facing applications, data platforms, and cloud services that support our restaurant technology and robotics products. This role has a strong emphasis on building modern, intuitive React-based front-end applications and data-driven dashboards, while also contributing to the Python services, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure that power them.

You will work across the full stack—from React and TypeScript user experiences to backend data services and AWS infrastructure. You will collaborate closely with product, robotics, data, analytics, and other engineering teams to turn complex operational data into simple, actionable applications.

We expect engineers to make extensive use of modern AI-assisted software development, particularly Claude and GitHub Copilot, to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, code review, and analysis. You should be comfortable using AI as part of your everyday engineering workflow while maintaining strong engineering and quality standards.

### **Responsibilities**

* Develop customer-facing applications using React, TypeScript, and JavaScript
* Build responsive, intuitive dashboards and interfaces that transform complex restaurant and robotics data into clear operational insights
* Develop reusable React components, visualization tools, and front-end frameworks
* Build and maintain Python backend services, APIs, data services, and databases supporting web applications and analytics
* Design data models and services that efficiently deliver operational and analytical data to front-end applications
* Develop APIs connecting front-end applications with cloud services, robotics data, analytics systems, AI applications, and third-party platforms
* Build and improve data pipelines that collect, transform, aggregate, and expose data for applications and analytics
* AI-generated insights, reporting, and automated workflows
* Integrate AI-powered capabilities such as conversational interfaces, recommendations, summaries, and operational insights into applications
* Use Claude and GitHub Copilot extensively in day-to-day development for code generation, debugging, refactoring, testing, documentation, code review, and rapid prototyping
* Create architectural and data-flow diagrams describing interactions between applications, backend services, data pipelines, AI systems, and robotics systems
* Monitoring, logging, and observability capabilities for front-end and backend systems
* Contribute to AWS deployment pipelines, application performance, scalability, and reliability

### **Requirements**

* BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 3+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including internships or equivalent project experience
* Experience with Claude Code and other agentic software development tools
* AI coding tools effectively for implementation, debugging, refactoring, automated testing, documentation, and learning unfamiliar code
* Strong experience developing modern web applications using React, TypeScript, and JavaScript

Taco Bell was born and raised in California and has been around since 1962. We went from selling everyone's favorite Crunchy Tacos on the West Coast to a global brand with 7,500+ restaurants, 350 franchise organizations, that serve 42+ million fans each week around the globe. We're not only the largest Mexican-inspired quick service brand (QSR) in the world, we're also part of the biggest restaurant group in the world: Yum! Brands. Much of our fan love and authentic connection with our communities are rooted in being rebels with a cause. From ensuring we use high-quality, sustainable ingredients to elevating restaurant technology in ways that haven't been done before... we will continue to be inclusive, bold, challenge the status quo and push industry boundaries. We're a company that celebrates and advocates for different, has bold self-expression, strives for a better future, and brings the fun while we're at it. We fuel our culture with real people who bring unique experiences. We inspire and enable our teams and the world to Live Más.

***At Taco Bell, we're Cultural Rebels. Want to join in on the passion-fueled fun? Learn more about the career below.***

**About the Job**

The SOFTWARE ENGINEER III is responsible for developing, testing, deploying, and supporting scalable software and integration services within Taco Bell's Customer Middleware platform, helping connect digital ordering, loyalty, customer identity, messaging, and restaurant experiences. In this role, you will contribute to technical design, implement solutions within established architecture and engineering patterns, and help strengthen the reliability and maintainability of Taco Bell's customer technology ecosystem alongside an experienced team of engineers. The SOFTWARE ENGINEER III will report to the Sr. Manager, Software Engineering as an individual contributor.

  

**The Day-to-Day**

* Build, test, deploy, and maintain cloud-based APIs, event-driven services, integrations, and data-processing workflows that support customer identity, loyalty, digital ordering, messaging, customer care, and restaurant experiences.

* Contribute to translating product and business requirements into technical designs, API contracts, implementation plans, and well-defined engineering stories, working with senior engineers, architects, and partner teams to identify integration dependencies, edge cases, and operational risks.

* Participate in code and technical design reviews, provide actionable feedback to peers, and apply and contribute to established engineering standards for reliability, security, maintainability, observability, automated testing, and deployment.

* Investigate and help resolve complex production and non-production issues using application logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and test results; collaborate with engineering and platform teams on remediation of environment-dependent behavior, rate limits, integration failures, and security findings.

* Contribute to improvements in the engineering lifecycle by addressing technical debt, applying reusable software patterns, expanding automation, documenting system behavior, and supporting secure, dependable releases through CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code practices.

  

**Is This You?**

* At least 5 years of professional software engineering experience developing and supporting production applications, APIs, distributed services, or integration platforms, with a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent years of experience.

* Hands-on experience with a modern server-side programming language and ecosystem (preferably TypeScript/JavaScript and Node.js), including automated unit and integration testing, debugging, dependency management, and maintainable software-development practices.

* Experience developing and integrating REST or GraphQL APIs, asynchronous events, queues, and service-to-service integrations, with an understanding of authentication, error handling, retry behavior, idempotency, and API-contract management.

* Experience building or operating applications on a major cloud platform, preferably AWS, using services such as Lambda, API Gateway, AppSync, S3, DynamoDB, EventBridge, SQS, CloudWatch, or comparable managed services.

* Experience with modern delivery and engineering tools and practices such as Git, GitLab CI/CD, infrastructure as code (AWS CDK or CloudFormation), Jira, Confluence, API specifications, and observability platforms.

* Demonstrated experience collaborating with product, QE, platform, security, senior engineers, and partner engineering teams to move work from technical discovery and implementation through testing, production deployment, monitoring, and operational support in high-volume transactional systems.

jobs.description:
**Application Developer**  
  
**Caltech**

**Job Category:** Fulltime Regular  
**Exempt Overtime Eligible:** Exempt  
**Benefits Eligible:** Benefit Based
  
  
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.  
  
**Job Summary**  
  
IPAC at Caltech has an opening for an experienced Application Developer to manage the Data Systems development team at the NASA/IPAC Infrared Science Archive (IRSA). This is first and foremost a people-management and leadership role: you will supervise, mentor, and set priorities for a team of software developers, represent the team to stakeholders, and guide its technical direction, while the team builds the tools that let astronomers and data scientists all over the world access and explore IRSA's petabyte archives of astronomy data.  
  
IPAC, part of the Physics, Math, and Astronomy Division at Caltech (www.caltech.edu), provides science operations, user support, data and archive services, and scientific vision to enhance discovery with observatories both in space and on the ground.  
  
IRSA (http://irsa.ipac.caltech.edu) is the steward of scientific data sets delivered by NASA's Astrophysics missions. We enable ground-breaking scientific research using data from these and other missions. IRSA ingests petabyte-scale imaging datasets, maintains multi-billion row databases, and develops a variety of tools for accessing, visualizing, and analyzing data from cutting-edge astronomical facilities. Current missions include SPHEREx, a NASA mission which will conduct a spectroscopic, infrared survey of the entire sky; and Euclid, a European Space Agency (ESA) mission to study the geometry and nature of the dark Universe. We are also preparing to support upcoming astrophysics missions including NEO Surveyor, a mission designed to discover and characterize most of the potentially hazardous asteroids that are near the Earth.  
  
**Essential Job Duties**  
  
As IRSA Data Systems Team Lead you will supervise a group of IRSA developers who share the overarching goal of supporting community science with archival IRSA and other NASA data sets, set direction on technical approach, and work with scientists and other stakeholders to interpret and implement project requirements. You will also lead the team through IRSA's transition of services and data to the cloud. Essential job duties include:  

* Estimating workforce needs, participating in hiring, and tasking team members appropriately to achieve deliverables on schedule.
* Supervising, mentoring, and evaluating the performance of team members
* Coordinating and strategizing with other IRSA team leads.
* Representing IRSA and IPAC to multiple stakeholders and the astronomy community.
* Setting technical direction and reviewing the team's design and architecture decisions.
* Leading IRSA's transition of services and data into the NASA cloud environment, including planning, sequencing, and staffing the migration.
* Guiding the development of tools that help scientists combine, extract, and exploit information from archived datasets.
* Overseeing the operation of efficient search and retrieval mechanisms for IRSA's petabyte-scale, growing data holdings.
Ensuring databases and archive content remain maintained and up to date.  

  
  
**Basic Qualifications**  
  
If you have the following in your background, then we want to hear about your interest in joining our team:  

* Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Sciences, or related field.
* Experience directly supervising or managing a team of software developers or engineers, including hiring, task assignment, and performance management.
* 8+ years' experience as a professional software developer in a Unix/Linux environment.
* Proficiency in one or more of C, C++, or Python.

Positron AI is building next-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low-latency, high-throughput large language model inference. **Role Overview**
=================

This engineer will improve end-to-end large language model (LLM) inference performance on Positron's custom AI accelerators, including our FPGA-based Atlas systems and our Titan systems built on the Asimov ASIC. * Develop and optimize distributed inference capabilities, including efficient KV cache management and data movement across heterogeneous hardware.

IRSA (http://irsa.ipac.caltech.edu) is the steward of scientific data sets delivered by NASA's Astrophysics missions. IRSA ingests petabyte-scale imaging datasets, maintains multi-billion row databases, and develops a variety of tools for accessing, visualizing, and analyzing data from cutting-edge astronomical facilities. new_jobs.description:
**About Positron AI**
=====================

Positron AI is building next-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low-latency, high-throughput large language model inference. Our first-generation ASIC, Asimov, is a cutting-edge accelerator targeting frontier AI workloads, with additional generations already underway.

**Role Overview**
=================

This engineer will improve end-to-end large language model (LLM) inference performance on Positron's custom AI accelerators, including our FPGA-based Atlas systems and our Titan systems built on the Asimov ASIC. The work spans hardware-accelerated attention, accelerator tuning, distributed KV cache, and scalable inference serving architectures. It covers profiling, algorithms, GPU-side data preparation, host-to-device data movement, runtime behavior, and measurement on production-relevant models.

You will join a small, performance-focused team that is expected to optimize the whole stack, and not merely tune isolated kernel interfaces. The goal is to sustain a repeatable path from observing workload symptoms to identifying root causes and creating measured improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Performance Profiling and Optimization**

* Profile and optimize latency, throughput, utilization, and efficiency across hardware-accelerated attention, accelerator configuration, the device runtime, host software, and on-device execution.
* Use performance counters, hardware and software traces, telemetry, and simulation to isolate regressions and validate fixes.

### **Distributed Inference and KV Cache**

* Develop and optimize distributed inference capabilities, including efficient KV cache management and data movement across heterogeneous hardware.

### **Benchmarking and Test Infrastructure**

* Build representative benchmarks and workload traces that expose bottlenecks in compute, memory, chip-to-chip interconnect, networking, scheduling, and model loading.
* Partner with test engineers embedded in the team to turn performance findings into durable regression tests and release gates.

### **Architecture Influence**

* Influence hardware and software architecture and interfaces where measured performance reveals a structural limitation.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Strong C++ and Python skills, with hands-on experience profiling and optimizing complex systems that exercise Linux VFIO interfaces..
* Deep understanding of memory hierarchy, concurrency, data movement, batching, scheduling, and performance measurement.
* Hands-on experience using profilers, counters, traces, and statistical methods to distinguish signal from noise.
* Demonstrated ability to debug across application, runtime, driver, firmware, and hardware boundaries.
* Experience bringing up software on new silicon, and debugging and analyzing performance optimizations in customer production deployments.
* Enthusiasm for AI-accelerated software development, including using coding agents and orchestrating subagents to move faster without compromising engineering outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with CUDA, HIP, Triton, GPU kernel development, distributed inference, or KV cache systems.
* Familiarity with transformer inference, mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, model serving, FPGA or ASIC accelerators.
* Working knowledge of Perfetto, Linux perf, eBPF, simulation, or hardware performance counters.

### **Leveling & Scope**

While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

Within the first 12 months:

* A baseline performance scorecard exists for priority workloads, with repeatable measurement and clearly identified bottlenecks.
* At least one major bottleneck in hardware-accelerated attention, accelerator tuning, or distributed inference has been removed, with an automated regression guard in place.
* A key distributed inference data path has a working implementation with quantified end-to-end cost.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

* Work on a small, high-leverage performance team with the mandate to debug and improve the full stack, from application code down to firmware and hardware, rather than being confined to a single layer.
* Help shape the distributed inference architecture and KV cache strategy for a custom inference accelerator at a formative stage, with direct influence over interfaces and system design.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

The base salary range for this role is $200,000 – $300,000.

Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits.

At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact.

**Benefits & Perks**
--------------------

We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future.
